messages:
kevin: Quick sync — we need to slot the RFC review for the new async batching RFC. Who can present and who's available to review next Tue/Wed window?
lia: I can present. prefer Tue afternoon (PST).
alex: I can review. Wed morning (PST) is best for me.
sarah: I have a conflict Tue 3–4pm, but can do Tue before 2pm or Wed after 11am.
mike: Available both days but would prefer earlier in day.
jen: If we do Tue I'm +1 but might have to duck out for a client call around 1pm.
kevin: Thanks — looks like Tue before 2pm PST gives the most overlap. Can we aim for Tue 11am PST / 19:00 UTC?
lia: works for me. I'll plan to present and keep it to 25m + 10m Q&A.
alex: 11am works. Can someone add the pre-read link? I'll try to skim beforehand.
kevin: Pre-read here: https://redwood_internal/rfcs/async-batching-draft (internal) — please add quick comments inline.
sarah: left a high-level comment about latency vs cost tradeoffs.
mike: left a short comment on the batching heuristic section.
jen: added 2 nit comments; nothing blocking.
kevin: Agenda draft: 1) 5m context & goals (lia) 2) 25m walkthrough + perf data (lia) 3) 10m focused review on rollout plan (all) 4) 5m next steps & owners. Please add any agenda items now.
alex: Can we add an item to confirm fallback model behavior and observability hooks? critical for Dedicated customers.
kevin: added that as item 3a.
lia: small ask — can someone from infra confirm whether the new KV cache changes need infra schema wins? @mike?
mike: I'll verify today and update the RFC or drop a note in the doc.
jen: also: will this change require any console UI updates? putting a placeholder for product follow-up.
kevin: good call. tagging @sarah for product/console follow-up after review.
sarah: will scope the UI impact after the meeting.
kevin: who wants to be the designated notetaker? we should capture decisions + rollout owners.
jen: I can take notes.
kevin: thanks. I'll send the calendar invite now with the agenda and link to pre-read. Please add 'must-read' reaction (:eyes:) if you've read the doc by EOD Friday.
lia: will do.
alex: FYI — I may be late 10m, but will join.
rfc-bot: Meeting created: RFC Review — async-batching-draft, Tue 11:00 PST, attendees: kevin, lia, alex, sarah, mike, jen. Calendar invite sent.
kevin: perfect. if anything changes ping here. otherwise see you Tue.
